name: the-penguin
description: Remotion build of the music video for "I'm the Penguin"

scripts.studio: npm run audio && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.animatic: npm run audio && node scripts/render.mjs Animatic out/animatic-540p.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=26
scripts.film: npm run audio && node scripts/render.mjs Film out/film-1080p.mp4 --crf=18
scripts.film:stills: npm run audio && node scripts/cut-stills.mjs --comp Film --clean --out out/film-stills
scripts.film:share: remotion ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/film-1080p.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -tune animation -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/im-the-penguin-film.mp4
